_comment: Shared truth table for the quad validator, which exists twice: in
src/quad.js so a cropper is told immediately, and in the trainer's
crops.validate_quad, which is the authority that gates the corpus.
Two implementations of the winding contract would otherwise drift, and
the drift would be silent -- a mirrored crop is a valid-looking crop.
Both test suites read this file, so a change to one side that the
other does not follow fails a test rather than corrupting ground truth.

cases.why: the rubber band's own corner order: TL, TR, BR, BL
a card photographed at an angle, still clockwise on screen
three points is not a quad
five points is not a quad
four clicks in nearly the same place is a misclick, not a crop
counter-clockwise: a rectangle that would crop mirrored
bow-tie from a swapped adjacent pair, area well over the floor
